RustyShelf 0.6.5 lets you open a game's case in Inspect, takes as many PC games folders as you like, and shows the buttons of the device you're using.

## New

- **Open the case.** In Inspect (V, R3, the quick menu's Inspect tile, or Details → Inspect the box), Enter opens a console game's case: the manual's first page inside the cover, and the disc, cartridge, UMD or floppy in its tray. Enter again takes it out, to turn on its own; hold Enter to play. Esc steps back. ([#2](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues/2))
- **Closer looks.** Inspect zooms in to 3×; zoomed in, WASD or the left stick moves round the box. The mouse works too: drag to turn, the wheel to zoom, a click for the next step, a right-click to step back, and a double-click on the shelf to pick the case up.
- **PC games folders.** Settings → PC games and apps → PC games folders: add as many as you like and take one off, as for a console's games folders. ([#7](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues/7))

## Changed

- In Inspect, Enter opens a console game's case a step at a time instead of playing it at once; Steam and PC games still play at once.

## Fixed

- **How to get it** opens your browser on Windows, not File Explorer. ([#1](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues/1))
- **Key legends** in Settings and the other menus show your controller's buttons or your keyboard's keys, not both; a controller counts from the start, and moving a stick counts too. ([#3](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues/3))
- **Console order** lists every shelf along the top, those with only the emulator's case too. ([#4](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues/4))
- A case turned on end in Inspect has a top and a bottom, instead of being open.

## Download

| | File | |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `RustyShelf-0.6.5-windows-setup.exe` | The installer. |
| | `RustyShelf-0.6.5-windows.zip` | The app and its `data` folder, to unzip anywhere. `--windowed` starts it in a window. |
| **Linux** | `RustyShelf-0.6.5-linux.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it once, then start it. |
| **Android** | `RustyShelf-0.6.5-android.apk` | arm64. Installs over 0.6.x. |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` has each file's SHA-256 sum.

The manual lists [everything that works](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/blob/rustyshelf/docs/MANUAL.md#what-works). Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues).
